approved_scope.title: Updater changelog extraction stays linear on a large UTF-8 section (the release notes check no longer takes seconds)
approved_scope.description: Updater changelog extraction stays linear on a large UTF-8 section (the release notes check no longer takes seconds)
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Performance fix in the bash updater helper: extract_changelog_section's emptiness check used ${out// }, which is quadratic in a UTF-8 locale; replaced by an equivalent linear regex. Behaviour and output are unchanged, so no requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: extract_changelog_section returns the same section as before; on a 400 KB UTF-8 section under LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 it finishes in under 2 s (tests/update-helpers.test.ts), and the 0.0.34 section extracts well inside the 5 s test timeout on CI
